newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on political uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Monday as major investors kept to the sidelines because of political uncertainty. Dealers said they saw little hope of a turnaround before the February 3 general elections.
"Only jobbers are active. Institutions, as well as foreign and local investors, are all silent," dealer Sajad Mankani said.
"Uncertainty looms large on the political and economic fronts. People are even unsure if the elections will be held."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 23.85 points, or 1.73 percent, to end at 1,353.16 amid 156 losers and 46 gainers. PTCL fell 1.35 rupees to 24.55. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
